question: How many days of annual leave do employees get?
answer: Full-time employees receive 24 days of paid annual leave per calendar year.

question: When is salary paid?
answer: Salaries are paid on the last working day of each month.

question: How do I update my bank details for payroll?
answer: Update your bank details in the HR portal under My Profile before the 20th of the month.

question: Who approves leave requests?
answer: Leave requests are approved by your line manager in the HR portal.
